description: Hand a task to AIPayGen's assistant in plain words: look things up (prices, news, weather, websites, wallets, tokens), set alerts (watches) and repeating routines that report to your phone, or message you. It picks and calls the right tools, paid from your key at their normal price (at most 4 tools and $0.05 per message). Free to ask.

history.description: Earlier turns of this conversation, oldest first.

message.description: What you want, e.g. "Every morning at 8 UTC send me x402 news, and alert me if ETH goes above 5000".

name: assistant
